literal: Having been kin those who abandoned oneself kinship estrangement cause without will come.
translation: Relatives who were once close but left you will return when the cause of their estrangement is removed.
modern: முன்பு உறவினராக இருந்து பின் பிரிந்து சென்றவர்களின் உறவு, அவர்கள் பிரிந்ததற்கான காரணம் நீங்கியவுடன் தானாகவே திரும்பி வரும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how to reunite with estranged relatives. Sometimes family members who were once close leave because of a specific disagreement or displeasure. The poet observes that their kinship is not permanently lost; they will naturally return to the fold once the underlying cause of their estrangement is resolved.
